# External skill manifest

Generated from `supabase/functions/_shared/growth-os/registry/external-skills.ts`. Verified 2026-11-14: each repo exists. Agent-skill repos were fetched at the pinned commit into an isolated directory, and the SKILL.md files and scripts were read and scanned for network calls, shell execution and instructions aimed at the agent. Nothing is installed or executed by agents.
